name: LASER_F_START_OFF
meaning: PostLoadInit: LaserProperty(8) sets it; state 0 goes to OFF (1) instead of ON (3)

name: LASER_F_SWITCH_ARMED
meaning: Reset sets it (6); HandleMessage 0x20 acts only when clear, then sets it (inferred)

name: LASER_F_TOGGLE
meaning: Reset / Laser_Create set it; HandleMessage toggles it (inferred)
